We will be introducing bipartisan legislation to block any and all purchases of Russian oil. It will be called the "Ronald Reagan Peace Through Strength Act." It will be forced to the Floor via discharge and it will pass overwhelmingly.

The bill announcement landed as Trump’s Russia arrangement outlined a much bigger supply schedule than the initial tranche. In a social media post, Trump laid out additional volumes of 500,000 tons during November, followed by 1,000,000 tons after that, and then another 3,000,000 tons depending on refinery conditions.

children: Energy traders reacted quickly to the prospect of more diesel hitting the market. Heating oil futures, a key U.S. diesel benchmark, dropped 4.33% to $4.67 a gallon on Friday afternoon, after earlier trading around a 52-week high of $5.43 and compared with a 52-week low of $2.05, based on Trading Economics data.
AAA put the national diesel average at $6.28 a gallon on Friday, down from a Sept. 22 record of $6.53 but still far above $3.68 a year earlier.
